about: The demo flavor's cuts (logic/Core/Demo.cs; the owner 18 Nov 2026: 'a very straightforward demo getting to town and then the dungeon'; no arena survivor mode, no story). Read only when the build has the feature 'demo' (export preset 'Windows Demo') or a dev run passes --demo. Every entry is one guard at one choke point: empty a list or set a switch false to bring that thing back; nothing here touches the full game. A trailing * matches a prefix.

steps.text: Take the Old Road out of the east gate, into Thornhollow Verge
The Den under Wolf Hollow lies beyond
Find the Den under Wolf Hollow and clear it
The den is different every time you go down
